input.requirement_description: We need to let brands create campaigns on our platform. Brands should be able to post a brief describing what kind of content they want from creators, set a budget, and define who can apply. Once posted, creators can see the campaign in a marketplace. We already have a user system with brands and creators. This is the first version so don't overcomplicate things, but it should be production-ready. Target launch: 4 weeks.
input.context: The system is a FastAPI microservice called campaign-service. We have existing User and Content services. Tech stack: Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery.

structured_spec.overview: Enable brand users to create, manage, and publish campaign briefs to a creator marketplace. Campaigns describe content collaboration requirements, eligibility criteria, budget, and timeline.

user_stories.story: As a brand marketing manager, I want to create a campaign with a brief so that creators can understand what content I need.
acceptance_criteria: Brand can fill in: title (required, 5-100 chars), description (required, 20-2000 chars), content requirements (note type, min word count, min image count), target audience tags (1-5 tags from predefined list)
Brand can set budget: total budget (required, > 0), per-creator fee range (min_fee, max_fee where min_fee > 0 and max_fee >= min_fee)
Brand can set timeline: application deadline, content submission deadline, publish deadline (each must be in the future, and application_deadline < content_deadline < publish_deadline)
Brand can set creator eligibility: min follower count (default 0), min engagement rate (default 0%), required content categories (optional), region restrictions (optional)
Campaign is saved in 'draft' status after creation
Validation errors return specific field-level error messages

user_stories.story: As a brand marketing manager, I want to edit my campaign before it receives applications so that I can refine the brief.
acceptance_criteria: Brand can edit all fields of a campaign in 'draft' or 'pending_review' status
Brand can edit title, description, requirements, and timeline of an 'active' campaign ONLY if zero applications have been received
Brand cannot edit budget of an 'active' campaign (budget is locked once published)
Editing a campaign in 'pending_review' status resets it to 'draft'
Returns 403 if user is not the campaign owner
Returns 409 if campaign has applications and restricted fields are being edited

user_stories.story: As a brand marketing manager, I want to submit my campaign for platform review so that it can be published to the marketplace.
acceptance_criteria: Brand can submit a 'draft' campaign for review
System validates: all required fields are filled, budget >= min_fee × 1 (at least one creator can be paid), all deadlines are in the future
Campaign status changes to 'pending_review'
Returns 422 with specific validation errors if validation fails

user_stories.story: As a platform admin, I want to approve or reject campaigns so that only quality campaigns appear in the marketplace.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can approve a 'pending_review' campaign → status becomes 'active'
Admin can reject with a reason (required, 10-500 chars) → status becomes 'rejected'
Rejected campaigns can be edited and resubmitted by the brand
Returns 403 if user is not an admin
Brand is notified on approval or rejection (notification service integration)

user_stories.story: As a brand marketing manager, I want to pause or cancel my campaign so that I can control its lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Brand can pause an 'active' campaign → status becomes 'paused', campaign hidden from marketplace
Brand can resume a 'paused' campaign → status becomes 'active' (only if deadlines haven't passed)
Brand can cancel a campaign in any non-terminal status → status becomes 'cancelled'
Cancelling a campaign with accepted applications triggers notification to affected creators
Terminal statuses ('completed', 'cancelled') cannot be changed

user_stories.story: As a brand marketing manager, I want to view my campaigns so that I can track their status.
acceptance_criteria: Brand can list their own campaigns with pagination (default 20, max 100)
Brand can filter by status
Brand can view a single campaign's full details including application count
Returns 404 for non-existent campaign, 403 for campaigns owned by other brands

transitions.guard: all required fields valid, deadlines in future
publish deadline passed AND all content settled

edge_cases.scenario: Brand sets application_deadline in the past during creation
edge_cases.handling: Reject with validation error: 'application_deadline must be in the future'
Reject with validation error: 'max_fee must be >= min_fee'

edge_cases.scenario: Brand sets total_budget < min_fee (can't afford even one creator)
edge_cases.handling: Reject with validation error: 'total_budget must be >= min_fee (at least one creator must be affordable)'

edge_cases.scenario: Application deadline passes while campaign is 'active'
edge_cases.handling: Campaign remains 'active' but new applications are rejected with 'application deadline has passed'. Existing accepted creators can still submit content.

edge_cases.scenario: Brand tries to cancel campaign with accepted creators who have submitted content
edge_cases.handling: Allow cancellation but trigger notification to affected creators. Content already submitted enters a 'cancelled' review state. Settlement for completed work still proceeds per platform policy.

edge_cases.scenario: Admin approves campaign but application_deadline has passed between submission and approval
edge_cases.handling: Reject approval with error: 'Campaign deadlines have expired during review. Brand must update deadlines and resubmit.'

edge_cases.scenario: Concurrent edit: two brand team members edit the same campaign simultaneously
edge_cases.handling: Use optimistic locking (version field). Second write returns 409 Conflict with 'Campaign was modified by another user. Please refresh and retry.'

edge_cases.scenario: Brand tries to resume a paused campaign but deadlines have passed
edge_cases.handling: Reject resume with error: 'Cannot resume — application deadline has already passed. Please cancel or create a new campaign.'

clarifying_questions.question: Can multiple brand team members manage the same campaign, or is it single-owner?
clarifying_questions.impact: Affects authorization model — single owner is simpler, multi-user requires team/role concept on campaigns.
clarifying_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Single owner (the creating brand user) for v1.

clarifying_questions.question: Should campaign budgets be in a specific currency, or is the platform single-currency?
clarifying_questions.impact: Multi-currency requires exchange rate handling, currency fields on all monetary values.

clarifying_questions.question: Is there a maximum number of creators per campaign, or is it limited only by budget?
clarifying_questions.impact: Affects budget exhaustion logic and UI display.
clarifying_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Limited by budget only. max_creators is optional.

clarifying_questions.question: Should the platform review (admin approval) be mandatory, or can brands self-publish?
clarifying_questions.impact: Removing admin review simplifies the state machine but removes quality control.
clarifying_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Admin review is mandatory for v1 (trust & safety).

clarifying_questions.question: What happens to the budget when a campaign is cancelled — is it refunded immediately or held for settlement of in-progress work?
clarifying_questions.impact: Affects settlement service integration and financial reconciliation.
clarifying_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Budget for unaccepted applications is released. Budget for accepted creators with submitted content is held for settlement.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Campaign list endpoint should respond within 200ms (p95) for up to 10,000 campaigns per brand
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Brands with many campaigns need responsive dashboard

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Campaign CRUD operations must enforce ownership authorization — brands can only manage their own campaigns. Admin operations require admin role.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Prevent unauthorized access to competitor campaign data

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Campaign status transitions must be atomic and use optimistic locking to prevent concurrent modification conflicts
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Prevent invalid state transitions from race conditions

non_functional_requirements.requirement: All status transitions should be logged with timestamp, actor, previous state, and new state
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Support dispute resolution and platform compliance
